title: Anton Reicha: The String Quartets
author: Ron Drummond
why: DRAFT, rewrite in your own words: a multi-part restoration diary and argument for a body of quartets almost nobody has heard, written by the person who edited them back into existence. Scholarship with a pulse.

title: The String Theory
author: David Foster Wallace
why: DRAFT, rewrite in your own words: a profile of a player ranked 79th in the world that explains, better than anything written about champions, what professional tennis actually costs the people who play it.

title: Federer as Religious Experience
author: David Foster Wallace
why: DRAFT, rewrite in your own words: the essay everyone quotes about Federer, and the rare piece of sportswriting that tries to say what watching genius does to the watcher.

title: Kenny Felder's Essays
author: Kenny Felder
why: DRAFT, rewrite in your own words: a physics teacher's plain-language essays on philosophy and belief, notable for taking questions seriously without pretending to answer them.
